content.comment_body: This [product_name] system is causing real headaches for me. A client mentioned they couldn't adjust a timer using the [product_name] operator panel. I checked the program—everything seemed properly set up, and the simulation ran fine, but the timer isn’t updated via the message screen. I tried creating a new project with a simple on-delay timer and a corresponding message screen to test. In simulation, setting the on-time for the timer works perfectly, but after downloading to the operator panel and trying to edit the timer value there, nothing changes. What could be the problem here? Thanks for any help in advance. [user_name] [product_name] Comfort [version_no] [article_no] Windows 10 64-bit

Thread closed due to duplicate posting. The other post, titled 'Can't set value on [product_name] operator panel for On-Delay timer', can be found within the [product_name] category. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The original poster describes that, while simulation of timer adjustment via a message screen in the [product_name] programming environment works as intended, editing the timer value on actual hardware (operator panel) does not yield any changes. The thread did not yield a resolution and was closed as a duplicate.
